study type: Prospective randomized interventional study (Randomized Controlled Trial)
outcome: Efficacy and safety in prevention of postpartum hemorrhage (PPH)
cohort: The study included 100 women with singleton term pregnancies undergoing vaginal delivery.
finding: Carbetocin was statistically equal to oxytocin in preventing uterine atony and PPH, with similar uterotonic action and lesser requirement for additional uterotonic drugs.
mod_finding: The study found that carbetocin and oxytocin had similar efficacy and safety profiles for PPH prophylaxis specifically following normal vaginal delivery.
